details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:542-609 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: seed_blocked() removes `ai:blocked` and leaves only `ai:waiting-on-dependency`, and resume() then posts `/answer [auto-answered-by-poller]` without changing labels; the `/answer` gate in .github/workflows/plan.yml lines 981-1001 accepts only `ai:planning`, `ai:clarification` or `ai:blocked`, so it skips the run with `reason=missing_expected_phase_label outcome=skip`.
  WHY: The `AI_DEPENDENCY_WAIT_RESUMED_V1` marker makes `already_resumed()` true on every later tick, so nothing re-posts and the issue is stuck in `ai:waiting-on-dependency` for good; all three reviewers rated this BLOCKER (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash's finding also covers the `/reclarify` label drift in clarify.yml lines 1130-1134, listed separately below).
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:542-554 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: resume() posts `/reclarify` for `resume_reclarify` but never removes `ai:waiting-on-dependency`, and clarify.yml lines 1129-1134 add `ai:clarification` without removing the wait label.
  WHY: The issue stays in the waiting scan every tick (it logs `already_resumed`, and clear_latch runs each tick), and if `DEPENDENCY_WAIT_RESUME_ENABLED=false` is set, switch_off() adds `ai:blocked` next to the issue's current phase label, leaving conflicting phase labels.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:593-628 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: seed_blocked() is not idempotent across a partial failure: if the marker comment posts but `add_labels([WAIT_LABEL])` fails, the trusted-marker short-circuit (line 596; gemini cites line 613) returns "" on every later tick and never retries the label change.
  WHY: One transient label-write failure strands the issue in `ai:blocked` with a durable wait marker, and the resume loop scans only `ai:waiting-on-dependency`; all four reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:593-610 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ai:waiting-on-dependency` is not registered anywhere (it is absent from the scripts/label_helpers.sh lines 50, 115 and 153 color/description maps and from `_AI_PHASE_LABELS`, and from every label contract or ensure-labels call site), so `gh.add_labels(issue.number, [WAIT_LABEL])` returns 404 in repos without the label after the wait marker has already posted.
  WHY: On the first seedable tick the issue is stranded in `ai:blocked` with a stale marker that suppresses all future seeding (line 596 short-circuit), which defeats the issue's stated goal.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:518-539 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: clear_latch() keeps the last-iterated matching event as `newest_actor` without sorting by created_at, so it can treat an older pipeline label event as the newest `ai:needs-human` labeler.
  WHY: A human's later re-add of `ai:needs-human` can be read as "ours" and removed, which silences the human-needed digest; gemini and minimax claim the events API is newest-first, and luna notes that scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 23581-23586 sort events explicitly; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the ordering premise, saying `issues/<n>/events` is oldest-first, so last-match picks the newest.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:256-266 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: newest_trusted_wait() applies `reversed(_trusted(...))` to a GraphQL `comments(last: N)` result that it treats as newest-first, so it returns the oldest trusted marker.
  WHY: Resume and escalation logic would then use stale data; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this, saying GraphQL connections return nodes oldest-first even with `last:`.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:310-327 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: newest_trusted_wait() (line 316 `for index, comment in reversed(_trusted(comments, login))`) and `_newest_trusted_latch_is_ours` (line 355) assume oldest-first order, but GraphQL `comments(last: 30)` is newest-first, while `already_resumed` (line 337) iterates forward.
  WHY: The oldest trusted marker's `since`/`target` would drive resume, the dedupe key and escalation, and the tests pass only because the fixtures are in insertion order; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the newest-first premise.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:609 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: seed_blocked() discards the return value of `gh.remove_label(issue.number, BLOCKED_LABEL)`, so a failed removal leaves both `ai:blocked` and `ai:waiting-on-dependency` and no log line flags it.
  WHY: The issue appears in both the waiting and blocked result sets and sits in two phases until someone fixes it by hand; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same line only as a hardening suggestion (risk 1).
- docs/INVENTORY.md:325 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new script `scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py`, referenced from README.md:258-259 and from the agents fragment, has no Scripts row in docs/INVENTORY.md.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py makes the required CI job `tests-release-and-log-analysis` fail with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py"; the other reviewers raised this as a task gap (see below).
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2321-2348 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The last run diff adds the P3a STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED truthy block and the FP_JOB_ID jq filter to clarify.yml, which is outside the issue #8859 files_touched grant, and duplicates the same change in plan.yml.
  WHY: `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` fails, and the duplicated P3a logic has drifted into two places.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:40-41,1142,1318-1319 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The last run diff adds the P11a `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS = 180.0` budget and the `_retired_label_drain_deadline` global to a file outside the issue #8859 grant.
  WHY: tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py rejects the modification, and P11a belongs in its own PR.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:40-41,1142,1318-1319 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_retired_label_drain_deadline` is a module-level mutable global that `_delete_retired_labels` sets and `_drain_retired_label` reads, with no per-call context.
  WHY: Re-entry or a second test invocation overwrites the deadline, and a direct caller of `_drain_retired_label` silently loses the deadline.
- README.md:109-118 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The env-var rows for `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED`, `RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED`, `ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED` and `ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` belong to P2a/P2b, P11a and P11b, not P8b.
  WHY: Consumers upgrading to `@stable` will see documented variables with no backing code in this PR (for example, `ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED=false` does nothing).
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2331-2348 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER_ENABLED case statement (also .github/workflows/plan.yml lines 3489-3505) silently coerces unrecognized values to "false" with no `::warning::`.
  WHY: A typo such as `enabled`, `on:` or `1.0` silently disables the breaker, unlike the poller's `is_truthy`, which warns.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2348 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The FP_JOB_ID filter `((((.check_run_url // "") | capture("/check-runs/(?<id>[1-9][0-9]*)$") | .id) // .id)` (identical in plan.yml) uses an unguarded `capture`, which raises on a non-match, and its `// .id` fallback returns the Actions job id.
  WHY: Annotations are never fetched, or are fetched from the wrong endpoint, so the fingerprint degrades to `no-error-line`/`annotations_unavailable`; repo convention uses `capture(...)?` (review_autofix.yml:1789).
- agents.d/stuck-states-p8b-dependency-wait-resume.md:whole file | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` failed with "custom_instructions_too_large" (statusCode 422) on head SHA c74cd93d, and this PR adds another agents.d fragment plus README rows to the folded instructions.
  WHY: The reviewer check ends before reviewing and is red, though the failure cannot be fully mapped to one hunk (minimax_minimax-m3 raised this as a task gap).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no hunk in docs/INVENTORY.md in the PR or the last run diff, README.md:258 and agents.md:1849 reference the script, and `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (job 127171651619; run 42005670991, head SHA c74cd93d41158726b9659bdb029d71538ab14cd1) fails with "FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py" and "FAIL: README.md:258: references scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it"; docs/INVENTORY.md is outside the grant, so this needs a companion edit or a grant amendment

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml `/answer` phase-label gate (lines 981-1001), or the label handling in scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py resume() / seed_blocked()
  confidence=5
